Rule pack — plausibility and range checks

make_rule_pack_plausibility.Rd

Builds executable FlagRule objects for the plausibility and value-range checks from the core observability rule catalog.

Usage

make_rule_pack_plausibility(
  domain,
  key_vars,
  subject_var = "USUBJID",
  site_var = "SITEID",
  numeric_vars = character(),
  non_negative_vars = character(),
  value_ranges = list(),
  visit_order_var = NULL,
  max_within_change = list(),
  iqr_multiplier = 3,
  zero_rate_threshold = 0.5,
  low_cv_threshold = 0.01,
  round_rate_threshold = 0.9,
  owner_team = "Biostats",
  ...
)

Arguments

domain

Domain name targeted by the rules.

key_vars

Character vector of key variables.

subject_var

Subject identifier variable. Default "USUBJID".

site_var

Site identifier variable. Default "SITEID".

numeric_vars

Character vector of numeric variables to include in the statistical checks (R034, R035, R037, R038, R039).

non_negative_vars

Variables that must not contain negative values (R033).

value_ranges

Named list of two-element numeric vectors specifying hard c(min, max) bounds for R031 (e.g. list(AGE = c(0, 120), WEIGHT = c(1, 600))).

visit_order_var

Numeric variable used to order records within a subject for R037 (e.g. "ADY" or "VISITNUM").

max_within_change

Named list of maximum permitted consecutive change per numeric variable for R037 (e.g. list(AVAL = 100)). Variables absent from this list are skipped.

iqr_multiplier

Multiplier applied to the IQR to define the outer fence for R035. Default 3.0 (Tukey far-out rule).

zero_rate_threshold

Fraction of non-missing values that are zero above which R034 fires. Default 0.5.

low_cv_threshold

Coefficient of variation below which R038 flags suspiciously low variance. Default 0.01.

round_rate_threshold

Fraction of values divisible by 5 above which R039 fires. Default 0.9.

owner_team

Team assigned to follow up on flagged records.

Value

A list of FlagRule objects compatible with run_flags().

Details

Rule IDNameScope
R031Physiologically impossible valuesRecord
R033Negative values where not allowedRecord
R034Suspicious zero valuesGroup
R035Extreme statistical outliers (IQR)Record
R037Within-subject implausible changeGroup
R038Too-perfect data (low variance / CV)Group
R039Rounding pattern anomalyGroup

Examples

pack <- make_rule_pack_plausibility(
  domain           = "ADVS",
  key_vars         = c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT"),
  numeric_vars     = "AVAL",
  non_negative_vars = "AVAL",
  value_ranges     = list(AVAL = c(40, 300))
)
length(pack)
#> [1] 6
